title: Unused-cause style I-frame with private cause value on single command
purpose: Drive an ASDU parser through a complete I-format application message that uses a rarely handled cause-of-transmission value outside common operational causes while keeping the rest of the frame structurally consistent.
expected_behavior: Parser should accept the APCI and ASDU structure, then route or reject the command based on unsupported or implementation-specific cause-of-transmission handling without overrunning buffers.
constraints_preserved: APCI length 0x0e matches 4 control bytes plus 10-byte ASDU body.
TypeID 45 (C_SC_NA_1) is taken from supplied function text.
VSQ is 0x01, matching one information object and one command element.
Common address is encoded in two octets and information object address in three octets using conservative IEC 60870-5-104 prior assumptions.
Cause value 0x1f is used as a structurally valid but unusual/private-style cause; exact semantic label is inferred rather than verified from supplied sources.
issue_safety_notes: The object count is kept at one and the ASDU body fully contains one object, specifically avoiding the issue motif where VSQ/count exceeds the available payload.
